faqs.a:
Admission to adult businesses is restricted to persons of the age of 18 years or more
               during hours adult entertainment is being presented. This minimum age limitation also
               applies to any employees, agents, servants, or independent contractors working on
               the premises.
(Code 1981, § 4-32; Ord. No. 3217, § 3, 9-18-1995; Ord. No. 3810, § 3, 6-16-2003)
